purpose: 冻结 NEW 公式、100% Top3 信号及全部交易规则，追加研究2至10的每个整数槽位。

frozen_new.ranking: score descending, symbol ascending, stable; daily Top3 without threshold

execution.order_budget: equity at signal close divided by candidate slots
execution.corporate_actions_and_delistings: unchanged from verified pre-2025 raw audit

read_only_execution_counts.classification_order: duplicate symbol first, then no free slot; a signal receives at most one skip reason
read_only_execution_counts.occupancy_sampling: end of each evaluated trading session after new pending orders; occupied=pending+holdings

shared_q1_random_starts.source: Reuse exactly the 25 fixed Batch010 dates; five per year for 2020-2024, PCG64 seed 20261019.
shared_q1_random_starts.last_signal_date: calendar year end minus 37 calendar days

selection_rules.hard_gate: Every 2020-2024 full-window year has positive excess and worst annual strategy return is positive; each year's mean shared-Q1 excess is positive; full-window and all shared-Q1 runs end without positions or pending orders.
selection_rules.priority_within_hard_gate: Sort descending by strategy CAGR, then mean annual excess, then worst annual excess, then worst annual return, then ascending slots.
selection_rules.fallback_if_hard_gate_empty: Sort descending by outperform years, profitable years, worst annual excess, worst annual return, strategy CAGR, mean annual excess, then ascending slots.
selection_rules.raw_audit: Audit exactly the unique selected summary candidate. Raw data-integrity or raw performance-gate failure is retained and does not trigger reselection.

audit.raw_input: original unadjusted OHLC through 2024-12-31 plus verified complete pre-2025 corporate actions and delistings
